set.body: Decision on S3.7 (2026-10-05). The Compare summary's grouped and scale-dependent numbers (grandD, participant M/B/D, group means and n, pairedN, the n range) come from report(run, spec, scale), not from ResultSummary's hard-coded scale and grouping. spec = the reporting spec Compare shows; scale = the trail's scale. Remove those scalars from ResultSummary (a protocol change, numbered at landing), and migrate CompareSummary, the figures and the methods facts that read them. No studio arithmetic.
set.title: Compare summary reads report(run, spec, scale); remove scale-bound scalars from ResultSummary
